from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import json,hashlib
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
assert not d.exists(),'E9已有目录，不能覆盖'
d.mkdir();(d/'sources').mkdir()
proposal_rel='reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_causes_single_release_v1/next_experiment.json'
proposal=json.loads((root/proposal_rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8'));assert proposal['proposal_id']=='E9'
protocol={'study_id':'510300_FED_RESERVE_THREE_CAUSE_WEEKLY_SCORE_V1','experiment_id':'E9',
 'registered_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'phase':'FIXED_SOURCE_FIRST_THEN_SINGLE_MODEL_REGISTRATION',
 'question':proposal['question'],'selection_disclosure':proposal['selection_disclosure'],'why_distinct':proposal['why_distinct'],
 'source_scope':{'publication_years':[2022,2023,2024,2025],'official_release_index':proposal['source_scope_proposed']['official_release_index'],
 'max_index_pages':1,'max_calendar_support_objects':3,'max_release_pages':215,'max_concurrent':3,'attempts_per_url':2,'do_not_retry_403_429':True,
 'reuse_20230914_original':'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_causes_single_release_v1/sources/20230914_H41原公布表.html',
 'selection':'按完整官方实际公布日历的日期顺序，不以中国交易收益选周'},
 'source_fields':['Total factors supplying reserve funds','Total factors, other than reserve balances, absorbing reserve funds',
 'Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks','Reverse repurchase agreements','U.S. Treasury, General Account'],
 'source_gate':'四年完整实际公布日历、所有原表字段及统一周均/前周变化完整；逐表正文公布日与日历一致，准备金供给减吸收误差不超过3百万美元。不用当前修订序列代替原表，缺源不填0。',
 'availability':'实际正文公布日美东23:59:59转上海作为保守公开日上界，历史首版/实际当年收取未认证；在该上界之后首个中国交易日收盘完成状态，再取下一开盘原五日标签。',
 'features_control':proposal['features_control_proposed'],'features_joint':proposal['features_control_proposed']+proposal['joint_additions_proposed'],
 'cause_definitions':proposal['joint_additions_proposed'],'frequency':'每次实际H.4.1公布一行，发生在同一中国决定日的多根保留并仅最新一次供预测，不重复训练价格标签。',
 'training':{'lookback_sessions':504,'minimum_mature_events':12,'label_maturity':'exit_at<=decision_at','update':'每次合格公布'},
 'tree':{'max_depth':2,'min_samples_leaf':6,'random_state':20261001},'ridge_alpha':10,
 'score':'训练池拟合预测的中位百分位秩，不是概率。','evaluation':'全部五档；固定score>=80且预测净收益>0，按时间顺序排除持有重叠。',
 'label':'原固定10000份下一开盘至五个持有间隔后的开盘，分红权益、4bp佣金最低5元、10bp滑点、0.001报价；模型登记前确认复用实现。',
 'primary_period':['2024-01-01','2025-12-31'],'earlier_context':['2022-01-01','2023-12-31'],
 'increment_gate':{'primary_joint_mse_not_worse_than_matched_control':True,
 'primary_joint_high_mean_net5_positive':True,'primary_joint_high_mean_not_worse_than_matched_control_when_nonempty':True,
 'at_least_one_primary_joint_high_date_not_in_control':True,'at_least_one_primary_new_high_path_actually_uses_new_cause':True},
 'account_admission':'固定增量条件全部满足后另登记完整账户；不以早期或岭参考营救失败；不要求单分支独立达成整个体系的频率。',
 'model_execution_requires_source_gate_and_separate_registration':True,
 'parameter_searches':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,
 'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
(d/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
inputs=[proposal_rel,'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_causes_single_release_v1/result.json',
 'config/510300_financing_source_correction_20240808_v1.json']
freeze={'registered_at':protocol['registered_at'],'before_new_release_series_or_equity_labels':True,
 'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256((d/'protocol.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'input_hashes':{rel:hashlib.sha256((root/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for rel in inputs},
 'authority_config_snapshots':{rel:json.loads((root/rel).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for rel in ['config/510300_historical_cause_discovery_v1.json','config/510300_existing_data_training_mandate_v1.json']}}
(d/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print('E9来源阶段已登记：固定四年实际发布/三原因，缺源不回填；模型执行另登记。')
